name: dak
description: A local review inbox and message queue between you and the AI coding agents on your Mac.

scripts.build:ui: bun build ui/app.ts --outdir dist/ui --minify --target browser && cp ui/index.html ui/style.css dist/ui/
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --outfile dist/dak
scripts.build:release: bun run build:ui && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/release/dak-darwin-arm64 && bun build src/cli.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/release/dak-darwin-x64
